line: Someone copies your weekend plan today. Join forces; it's more fun anyway.
Your kind of day. Meet a friend for brunch and let the chat run long.
Someone looks after you today. Let them cook; you do the dishes.
A quiet afternoon sparks an idea. Keep a notebook within reach.
Family asks your opinion today. Give it gently; they'll actually listen.
Errands pile up today. Batch them into one trip, then put your feet up.
Good day to compare prices. The weekend sale can survive one more look.
A surprise offer turns up today. Say maybe, then read the fine print.
You've got a hot take today. Share it at dinner, not in the group chat.
Easy fun finds you today. Say yes to the movie; skip the large popcorn.
